idea-plugin.name: Android Studio MCP - Code Intelligence
idea-plugin.description:
Android Studio MCP – Code Intelligence exposes 12 IDE-level semantic analysis tools to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Instead of relying on grep and file reads, AI agents get direct access to the same understanding Android Studio uses internally — type resolution, reference graphs, call hierarchies, data flow analysis, and safe cross-language refactoring.

Tools

  • resolve_symbol — Fully-qualified type, declaration location, and symbol kind at any position
  • find_references — Semantic usages, callers, callees, and type hierarchy (zero false positives)
  • get_scope — All visible symbols: locals, members, extensions, imports
  • query_project — Project overview, dependency graph, API surface, build variants
  • query_framework — Room / Retrofit / Hilt / Compose / Navigation structural views
  • analyze_data_flow — Nullability inference, forward/backward value propagation
  • analyze_quality — Complexity hotspots, dead code, clones, error handling
  • check_rules — Custom architecture dependency rules validation
  • structural_search — AST-based pattern search with IntelliJ SSR syntax
  • refactor — Rename, move, extract, safe delete, change signature across Java/Kotlin/XML
  • checkpoint — Create, list, rollback, and diff IDE Local History snapshots
  • sandbox — Decompile library classes, Java-to-Kotlin conversion, batch inspections

Highlights

  • Embedded Ktor HTTP server with Streamable MCP transport — zero external dependencies
  • One-click Cursor configuration from the built-in Tool Window
  • Per-tool metrics: invocation count, token usage, execution time
  • Supports both K1 and K2 Kotlin compilers
